_doc: Patterns scanned in tool results of executing tools (Bash, MCP, web, agents) and in API error messages. Transcripts contain NO CPU/memory telemetry, so every signal is an inference. confidence_error applies when the tool call failed (is_error or non-zero exit), confidence_ok when the pattern merely appears in the output of a call that succeeded. Output of pure read commands (cat, grep, git show...) and of Read/Grep tools is never scanned.

signals.label: Disk full (ENOSPC)
signals.regex: ENOSPC|No space left on device|disk quota exceeded|not enough space on the disk
signals.hint: Free space (docker system prune, old build caches, duplicated node_modules/worktrees) or point caches to a bigger disk.

signals.label: Out of memory / killed
signals.regex: Out of memory|\bOOM\b|OOMKilled|oom-kill|JavaScript heap out of memory|FATAL ERROR:.*(heap|allocation)|Cannot allocate memory|MemoryError|std::bad_alloc
signals.hint: Cap parallelism (--workers, -j, NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size), do not run heavy jobs side by side, add swap or memory.

signals.label: Process killed (SIGKILL / exit 137)
signals.hint: Killed by the kernel OOM killer, a timeout wrapper or the harness: check memory headroom and the timeout before blaming the code.

signals.label: Timeouts
signals.regex: ETIMEDOUT|ESOCKETTIMEDOUT|Command timed out|timed out after|\bTimeoutError\b|deadline exceeded|Operation timed out|Read timed out|context deadline
signals.hint: Run long jobs in the background and wait on completion, raise explicit timeouts, check the remote side.

signals.label: CPU / process pressure hints
signals.regex: Resource temporarily unavailable|\bEAGAIN\b|fork: retry|Cannot fork|Too many open files|\bEMFILE\b|load average: (1[0-9]|[2-9][0-9])\.|cpu throttl
signals.hint: CPU or process limits may be saturated; compare with scripts/sample_machine.py output.

signals.label: GPU absent / driver missing
signals.regex: CUDA is not available|No CUDA GPUs|no NVIDIA (GPU|driver)|NVIDIA-SMI has failed|nvidia-smi: command not found|torch\.cuda\.is_available\(\)\s*(=|->|:)?\s*False|Found no NVIDIA driver|could not select device driver|no CUDA-capable device
signals.hint: This machine has no usable GPU; GPU-bound jobs fall back to CPU or fail. Use a GPU host or CPU-optimised builds (int8, quantised).

signals.label: CUDA out of memory
signals.regex: CUDA out of memory|CUDA error: out of memory|CUDNN_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED|OutOfMemoryError: CUDA|cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
signals.hint: Lower batch size or resolution, use fp16/int8, free GPU memory from other processes.

signals.label: Network errors
signals.regex: ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNABORTED|EHOSTUNREACH|ENETUNREACH|Network is unreachable|Connection refused|Connection reset by peer|SSL: CERTIFICATE|unable to access '.*'?: (Failed|Could not)|curl: \(\d+\)|Failed to connect|socket hang up|EPIPE
signals.hint: Retry with backoff in code, check proxy and firewall, avoid re-fetching big artefacts.

signals.label: DNS failures
signals.regex: ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|getaddrinfo|Temporary failure in name resolution|Could not resolve host|Name or service not known|NXDOMAIN|nodename nor servname
signals.hint: Resolver is flaky or the host is wrong; pin a resolver or cache dependencies locally.

signals.label: Rate limits (429)
signals.regex: (HTTP|status|error|code|Error)[^\n]{0,24}\b429\b|\b429 (Too Many|Client Error)|Too Many Requests|rate limit(ed| exceeded| reached)|quota exceeded|RateLimitError|rate_limit_error|secondary rate limit|retry-after:
signals.hint: Throttle and batch calls, use conditional requests and caching, avoid parallel hammering.

signals.label: API overloaded (529/503)
signals.hint: Upstream capacity problem; not a local bottleneck. Retry later or reduce concurrency.

signals.label: OS permission denied
signals.regex: Permission denied|\bEACCES\b|\bEPERM\b|Operation not permitted|Read-only file system
signals.hint: Fix ownership or mounts once instead of retrying with variants.

signals.label: Tool permission denied by user or policy
signals.regex: doesn't want to proceed|has been denied|Permission to use .* has been denied|was blocked by|requires approval|denied by (the )?(user|hook|policy)|hook blocking error
signals.hint: Add allow rules for safe repeated commands, or switch the run to a mode that does not stop for them.

signals.label: Dependency resolution failures
signals.regex: ERESOLVE|peer dep|Could not find a version that satisfies|ResolutionImpossible|No matching distribution|npm ERR! code E404|lockfile .* out of date
signals.hint: Pin versions and commit the lockfile; avoid trial-and-error installs.
